profile.headline: Web Developer II at the University of Houston
profile.summary:
Through my matriculation at Clark Atlanta University, with a Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media Arts with a concentration in Television, Radio and Film I have expanded my knowledge and skills by volunteering, interning, and working with different businesses and production companies within the media and entertainment industry. 

Working as an Assistant Video Editor and Video Editor for numerous of projects I plan to take the skills I learn into brighting my horizons so that I will know everything there is to know when branching off on my own.  I plan to become more well rounded in Videography as well.  I have great plans on creating a Production Company in my hometown, St. Louis, Missouri to help promote well known and upcoming artist all over the world, world wide and small owned businesses, schools from all over, the community, etc...

In the process of completing my goals I will give back to the community by speaking to juvenile delinquency children and teens letting them know the better ways to approach life. 

A quote that I live by: 

"Good, better, best. Never let it rest. Until your good is better and your better is best."
                                                                      -Tim Duncan

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description:
Supports a college or department website, including writing HTML documents, creating graphics, digitizing pictures, and inserting audio and video to enhance the look and feel of the website. Coordinates various web projects that uphold the image of the university to a worldwide audience.

- Develops content and layout of assigned web pages, using graphics software specifically designed for publishing on the Web.
- Creates and edits graphics for web and print; digitizes images using scanning and digital camera equipment.
- Assists with quality and usability testing of web pages to ensure compliance with departmental quality standards.
- Coordinates with contacts and updates information on the assigned website to ensure that the university is well represented.
- May administer a microcomputer based Web server for a college or department.
- Coordinates assigned projects and leads the work of other Web staff assigned to the projects.
- Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
positions.insights: Skills: Plesk · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Web Development · Project Management

positions.title: Media Coordinator
positions.description:
- Execute a results-driven media strategy.
- Develop and curate engaging content for social media platforms.
- Assist in the creation and editing of written, video, and photo content.
- Attend events and produce live content.
- Collaborate with marketing team to create a media calendar.
- Monitor social media and media platforms.
- Interact with parents and respond to media messages, inquiries, and comments.
- Review analytics and create reports on key metrics.
- Assist in the development and management of media marketing and influencer marketing
strategy.
positions.insights: Skills: Online Media Management · Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

positions.title: Web Developer & Graphic Designer | Owner
positions.description:
Our Graphic Designs are High-End and we make sure your business will be highlighted!  We love to design and surround ourselves in it every day.  Let us create and bring to life your graphics, websites, logos, photos, videos, business starter packets and promotional needs.  

From custom graphics to web development to business starter packets.  With over 10 years of experience you can be assured that your creative needs are in good hands.  

Quality and Creativity are very important to us.  Let us create a custom design for all your visual communication needs today!

"You Are Only Limited By The Limitations Of Your Creativity"

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Develop specialized web applications.
- Research and analyze facilities need to address application needs.
- Plan implementation of required applications.
- Develop user documentation for the implemented facilities.
- Train users on use of implemented facilities.
- Provide ongoing problem solving and support for implemented facilities.
- Use SEO and accessibility techniques to increase the visibility and diversity of Archdiocesan website properties. 
- Assist with graphic designs and design standards for the Archdiocese.
- Build websites on a daily base for implemented facilities.

positions.title: Graphic Designer, Video Editor & Web Developer
positions.description:
- Create videos, banners (full color), yard signs, foam card signs, car magnets, t-shirt designs, and business cards.
- Assist with helping customer market and advertise their business with promotional and business items.
- Provide daily data entry, generated email and contact information, and managed and maintained the phone lines. 
- Deliver exceptional customer service by establishing a positive relationship with customers.
- Take charge of the print shop, independently, while owner is away on business meetings or vacation.

Get Ready... Get Set... Grow...  Our mission is to become a perpetual resource to businesses and organizations who wish to feed their goals with creativity and quality to attain growth.

Visit www.APlusMediaGroup.com for more information.

positions.title: Graphic Designer Manager
positions.description:
- Managed all incoming artwork. 
- Maintained the web, screen print, embroidery, engraving and spangle departments. 
- Lead Graphic Designer Representative for main contractors such as Walmart, Johnny Mac, BSN Sports, Minute Man Press, etc.   
- Created graphics for t-shirts, banners, trophies, medals and mock up proofs for embroidery. 
- Separated more than 5 color artwork to be sent to the print floor.
- Worked with contractors and walk in customers daily.
- Managed company when owner was out. 
- Oversaw 5 managers and their departments. 
- Ensured all product was out fast and accurate.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Greet customers in a courteous, friendly, and professional manner using agreed upon procedures.
- Listen attentively to customer needs and concerns; demonstrate empathy.
- Clarify customer requirements, probe for and confirm understanding of requirements or problems.
- Meet customer requirements through first contact resolution.
- Effectively transfer misdirected customer requests to an appropriate party.
- Confirm customer understanding of the solution and provide additional customer education as needed.
- Communicate effectively with individuals/teams to ensure high quality and timely expedition of customer request.

positions.title: Photographer
positions.description:
- Capture realistic images and shoot videos as the assignment dictates.
- Pre-edit and edit images as needed and process photographs by resizing and retouching them.
- Ensure appropriate photo quality and work with clients to decipher projects needs.
- Wok with producers to ensure management of all photography assignments.
- Prepare shoot sites as needed for particular projects and set up equipment and tools as needed for projects.

positions.title: Assistant Editor for "Switching Lanes" Presented by Tyscot Films
positions.description:
- Transport footage from on set production to the editing Head Quarters, Radiant3 Productions.
- Save footage daily and create dailies to provide producers, director, and writer for viewing.  
- Sync daily video footage with the audio within a timely matter, using Adobe Premiere with no supervision.  
- Arrange/organize audio track using Adobe Audition.  
- Create copies of script notes, sound reports, and camera reports to provide to POC, Head Editor, and Scripty. 
- Locate and organize production days, time codes, and scene numbers from video dailies. 
- Provide daily feedback and reviews to the sound and camera team, to perfect recording.  


The new film, "Switching Lanes" is a coming of age story about two teen girls, Kaneesha and Sarah, who are aspiring tracks stars living “separate but equal” lives in the segregated town of Casterville. But God does work in mysterious ways as the two girls meet and find an irresistible affinity for one another, despite the negative reactions of their mostly racist friends.  Soon they discover a secret that will change their lives and their town, forever.

Starring Michael Lerner (GLEE), Marla Maples(Executive Decision), Terri J Vaughn (Steve Harvey Show), Victoria Staley (Raising Izzy), Fred Hammond (Gospel Artist) Wes Morgan (Gospel Artist), Kim Fields (Living Single), Angie Stone (R&B and Soul Artist), Kenny Lattimore (R&B Artist), and Tommy Ford (Martin).

Switching Lanes was written and co-produced by Raven Magwood, directed by Hollywood veteran actor/director, Tommy Ford (MARTIN, Fox New York Undercover, UPN The Parkers, TVOne Who Got Jokes), and produced by Shannon Nash, president of the Nash Management Group, Inc. a business and entertainment management company whose clients have included: Terri J. Vaughn, Jasmine Guy, Doc Shaw, Tommy Ford, Debbie Allen and Ne-Yo. Executive producer Bryant Scott. 

Tyscot Films will release Switching Lanes during the first quarter of 2014.

positions.title: Production Assistant & Makeup
positions.description:
- Prevented any unauthorized problems on the set, or any interference with the shooting process.
- Ensured that producers and property master had all necessary materials prior to shoot (props, walkie talkies)
- Managed all extras on film set and ensured their prompt arrival at each individual stage of filming. 
- Provided assistants to the Key Grip with the operation of lighting for the onset production. 
- Designed and created special make up effects using special effect makeup for main actors/actress and extras.

(September 29 - October 28, 2012)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted photographers to meet deadlines by recording and editing videos for the server with accuracy, quality and strong editorial judgment.  
- Video edited news packages in a timely matter using Avid Instinct (News Cutter).
- Practiced writing scripts in a timely matter for reporters and anchors using iNews. 
- Generated the news prompter as a live teleprompter for the daily news show.
- Used creative lighting, camera and audio techniques to enhance and develop news stories.
- Ensured regular communication with the anchors, director, and studio crew to ensure everything ran smoothly. 
-Shadowed Video Editors, Photographers, Producers, News Reporters, Assignment Desk Managers, Camera Operators, Director, Technical Director, etc.

positions.title: Marketing and Sales Intern
positions.description:
- Performed daily updates for online natural hair website with graphics and recent hair news. 
- Provided blog comment feedbacks to appropriate areas to keep in contact with daily subscribers. 
- Updated social media outlets such as Twitter and Facebook.

positions.title: Intern/Volunteer
positions.description:
- Operated DVX cameras for The Reverse The Lynch Curse Documentary, hosted by Tommy Ford.
- Recorded one-on one interviews as well as held boom microphone for the interviews.
- Assisted with the breaking down of camera equipment.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Worked closely with judges providing legal court files
- Alphabetizing and receiving files
- Running errands for judges and court clerk
- Distributed mail to judges from the mail room
- Interned with Angela Quigless, Circuit Judge

honors.title: AWS Technical Essentials
honors.description: AWS Technical Essentials introduces you to essential Amazon Web Services (AWS) and common solutions. The course covers the fundamental AWS concepts related to compute, database, storage, networking, monitoring, and security. You start working in AWS through hands-on course experiences. The course covers the concepts necessary to increase your understanding of AWS services, so that you can make informed decisions about solutions that meet business requirements. Throughout the course, you will gain information on how to build, compare, and apply highly available, fault tolerant, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
honors.issuer: Issued by Amazon Web Services · Mar 2023

honors.title: Lambda Pi Eta Honor Society, Theta Tau Chapter
honors.description: The goals are to recognize, foster, and reward outstanding scholastic achievement; stimulate interest in the field of communication; promote and encourage professional development among communication majors; provide an opportunity to discuss and exchange ideas about the field; establish and maintain close relationships and understanding between faculty and students; and explore options for further graduate studies. To become a member of Lambda Pi Eta, students must have completed at least 60 semester hours; have completed at least 12 semester hours of communication study and have a GPA of at least 3.25; have a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0; and be in the upper 35% of their graduating class.
honors.issuer: Issued by Clark Atlanta University, Mass Media Arts · Jan 2013

Throughout the course, you will gain information on how to build, compare, and apply highly available, fault tolerant, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.

honorsAndAwards.title: Lambda Pi Eta Honor Society, Theta Tau Chapter
honorsAndAwards.description: The goals are to recognize, foster, and reward outstanding scholastic achievement; stimulate interest in the field of communication; promote and encourage professional development among communication majors; provide an opportunity to discuss and exchange ideas about the field; establish and maintain close relationships and understanding between faculty and students; and explore options for further graduate studies. To become a member of Lambda Pi Eta, students must have completed at least 60 semester hours; have completed at least 12 semester hours of communication study and have a GPA of at least 3.25; have a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0; and be in the upper 35% of their graduating class.
